newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Changchai to issue cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Changchai to issue cash dividend.

text.p: Chinese diesel engine maker Changchai Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would make an after-tax dividend payment of 0.228 yuan per A share based on profits made in the January-August period of 1996.

Holders of the firm's hard currency B shares would not receive a 1996 dividend because the company's 100 million B shares were listed in Shenzhen only last September, Changchai said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Profits from September-December 1996 would be distributed along with the company's 1997 dividend issue to holders of both domestic currency A shares and B shares, the statement said.
The registration deadline for A shares was set on July 25 and the A shares would go ex-dividend on July 28, it said.
The company posted net profits of 230.7 million yuan in 1996, up from 203.1 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
